issues.title: Allow data table to be sorted by Reference or Updated columns
issues.body:
Some users would like the COA table to be sorted by document ID (so they're in persistent locations), and others would like them to be sorted in updated order.

We could support this with `Sort` icons on the relevant columns in the header.  The `updated` column currently shows the value produced by "moments" - which is difficult to sort.  Instead we should store the age (prob in millis) but convert that to `moment` on rendering.

I _guess_ we need to pass additional props to the data-table, maybe with a boolean on `sort`.

Obvs we need to re-run the Active Sort on table updates.
